perspective: 第三人称追尾视角，鼠标或触摸滑动转视角
core_experience: SUPERHOT式时间操控与马里奥平台跳跃混搭；慢速读弹幕、规划跳跃路线
controls: WASD/arrows move, Spacevariable/doublejump, run+Shiftlongjump/airpound, Ppause, Rretry, Tstats, optionaloriginalcamera.
game_loop: 标题点击进入→piOS终端剧情（可跳）→关卡内移动跳跃收集→触旗结算并解锁下一关→回放后进入下一关或评分；死亡后重试
content: 关卡为代码固定定义（源码LEVELS表，可见1-1 TIME IS A PLUMBER、1-2 SHELL GAME、1-3 BULLET BALLET等）；总关数未实机穷举
progression: 逐关解锁；localStorage保存当前关卡、统计与已学提示；死亡计入DEATHS
save: Originalpersonallevelprogress/crystals/learned/stats. ActualrefreshContinue1-2 andcontinued. Sessioncoins/score/deathsreset preserved, no persistenceclaim.
rules: 目标：抵达关卡末端旗杆；失败：坠落/被敌人或子弹击中死亡；计分：金币与击杀加分（具体公式未确认）；HUD含TIME（游戏内时间）、DEATHS计数
systems: 时间随动系统（不动时TIME×约0.03，操作时升高）；敌人含Goomba与Koopa射手（子弹随时间流动）；砖块/?砖可顶出金币或蘑菇；检查点与水晶收集；回放系统记录操作轨迹（仅源码确认）
ui_flow: 标题（CLICK TO PLAY/CONTINUE）→piOS剧情终端→关卡HUD（MARIO分数/COINS/WORLD/TIME/DEATHS/倍率/操作提示）→暂停层→结算/回放→评分（世界末）→下一关
level_design: 白色极简走廊式3D平台，含台阶、水管、砖块阵、敌人配置与隐藏水晶；教学化编排（先移动后跳跃再双跳/远跳）
verification: Desktop1280x720 original12level3Dplatformer entiremain.js byteSHA unchanged, originalnativefont/loading2bootstraps retained, exact7missingdeclaredfontfiles recovered atorigin withSHA. Hosttools/interception retired. ActualnativeWmovement/variablejump/stomp/coins/crystals/timefreeze/pause-resume/deathautoretry+R/checkpoints34/67/86.5/doublejump/assistedlongjump. Original1-1flag fullclear withscore3000/3coins/5deaths and2of3redcrystalicons atflag; originalreplay then1-2. NativeStats1-1 actual8tries1clear5deathsbest38.2s, otherlevelsnotplayed except1-2start. Reload titleContinue1-2, actualclickcontinued1-2. Originalsessioncoins/score/deaths resetonreload, no claim they persist. No all12clear/Boss/groundpoundplate/powerups/fire/rating/fullcrystals/mobile/hearing proof. Complete50requestwindow noexternal/failed/exception/truncation; one originalTHREEshaderX3577compilerprecisionoptimization warning, no consoleerrors or runtimeNaNrestore.
